title: Catholic Worship Director/Musician - GK
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.U.S. AIR FORCES IN EUROPE.FA5606  52 CONS DA LGC
description_text: This requirement is for a Catholic Worship Director/Musician to provide planning, coordination, rehearsal, and performance of music for Catholic worship services at Geilenkirchen NATO Air Base Chapel IAW Performance Work Statement. An amendment has been issued in accordance with the amended SF 1449 to extend the due date by 2 weeks, to 21 April 10:00Am CEST.
